scope: Fortnite service maintenance, downtime and incidents relevant to France/Europe
source_of_truth: Epic Games Public Status for service state; Fortnite News/official product sources only for linkage to season, patch or live-event context.

principles.service_state_separate_from_content: Epic Status confirms service availability and maintenance state; it does not by itself confirm patch content, season identity or gameplay features.
principles.stable_service_event_id: One logical maintenance/incident keeps one immutable service_event_id across all state changes.
principles.stable_calendar_uid: If a service event becomes calendar-worthy, it keeps one VEVENT UID across announcement, start, extension, recovery and resolution.
principles.no_calendar_for_every_incident: Unplanned incidents are persisted in this ledger but do not automatically create VEVENTs unless they become materially useful for planning.
principles.no_end_time_invention: Never invent expected or actual recovery time. Unknown end remains null.
principles.relation_requires_evidence: Link downtime to a season, patch, live event or tournament only when an official source explicitly establishes the relationship.
principles.europe_paris_display: Published timestamps may be stored in source timezone/UTC but any actionable calendar time for the user is rendered with an explicit timezone and converted reliably to Europe/Paris.

calendar_policy.scheduled_maintenance: Create/update a VEVENT when an official maintenance start date/time or clearly actionable maintenance window is published.
calendar_policy.unplanned_incident: Do not create a VEVENT by default. Promote only if the incident becomes long-running/material enough that a calendar object provides planning value, or if an official recovery/maintenance window is published.
calendar_policy.sequence_rule: Increment SEQUENCE only when the VEVENT's business data changes. Ledger-only state verification does not increment it.
calendar_policy.dtend_policy: Use DTEND only when an official expected end/window is explicitly published. Never infer a maintenance duration.
calendar_policy.resolved_policy: Keep the same UID. Do not delete a resolved maintenance event; remove future alarms and mark service state RESOLVED.

notification_policy.DOWNTIME_ANNOUNCED: Notify once when an actionable scheduled start/window is newly published, especially for a season launch, major patch or live event.
notification_policy.STARTED: Notify once for major/total impact or high-interest linked season/live event; otherwise ledger/ICS update may remain silent.
notification_policy.EXTENDED: Notify when the official expected recovery/window is materially extended, or when an announced duration becomes materially longer. Never infer extension merely because service is still unavailable.
notification_policy.RECOVERING: Usually silent unless a prolonged major outage is materially improving and the update is useful.
notification_policy.RESOLVED: Notify once after major/total or prolonged downtime; routine scheduled maintenance resolution may remain silent.
notification_policy.CANCELLED: Notify if a previously actionable scheduled maintenance was cancelled or moved.

relation_policy.season_launch: Epic Status alone may confirm the maintenance, but season_id/related_event_uid require Fortnite News/Battle Pass/other authorized official evidence that this downtime deploys that season.
relation_policy.patch: patch_version requires an official patch/update reference; never infer a version number from timing alone.
relation_policy.live_event: Link to a live event only when official communication associates the downtime with that event.
relation_policy.competitive: Do not treat ordinary tournament matchmaking issues as a planned competitive maintenance unless Fortnite Competitive/Epic Status explicitly establishes it.

watch_targets.promotion_rule: Create a service entry only when Epic publishes an actual maintenance/incident record or an official actionable downtime window. Link it to the next season only if official content evidence establishes that relation.
